item.title: Canada retaliates with tariffs on $20 billion of US goods as trade war escalates
item.description: This is the latest escalation in a trade rupture between two countries with one of the world's most integrated economic relationships, including close defense and security cooperation and the USMCA/CUSMA trade pact that Trump himself negotiated in his first term. item.title: Russian strikes kill at least two in Kyiv as three-day truce ends
item.description: Russian airstrikes killed at least two people and wounded 10 others in Kyiv early Tuesday, Ukrainian officials said, as a three-day mutual pause in strikes on the Ukrainian and Russian capitals expired. Kyiv authorities said air defenses were activated and residents were urged to seek shelter…

item.title: Apple expected to launch first foldable iPhone as Xiaomi unveils wide foldable with Arm’s new AI GPU
item.description: Apple is almost certain to launch its first foldable iPhone tomorrow, seven years after Samsung’s Galaxy Fold, according to reports. item.title: Novartis shares tumble after third drug trial setback in a week
item.description: Novartis shares fell as much as 10% in early trading Tuesday after the company announced that its experimental drug del-desiran failed to improve muscle function in a late-stage trial, marking the third clinical setback for the Swiss pharmaceutical giant in a week.
